column1: This is a spreadsheet to account for and visualise money owed to the pot.
When borrowing money from the pot you MUST account for the amount AND date borrowed followed by selecting "OUTSTANDING" under the status collumn.
You may also choose to write down a note in the notes collumn for tracking/organisation.
When paying back money to the pot you must select the date you paid the money back and change from "OUTSTANDING" to "PAID".
When viewing the table you can SortBy the view by clicking on the dropdown arrow next to the :Loan date" collumn and select --> Sort collumn --> Sort Z - A
